notes.title: July Patch/Minor Update
notes.content:
[b]Hello Drafters![/b]

Apologies for the long delay in updates. I have been slowly making some fixes, adjustments, and improvements to OpenDraft while simultaneously working on Maroxyn. But for the moment, it is only minor updates and improvements that are to be pushed. The major update is still underway.

[b]In this update:[/b]

- The Controls bar is now always visible and is at the bottom of the screen,
- The Text Boxes are now dynamic and resize with the content inside,
- The Text Boxes now have a Title field,
- The To-Do lists are now a single entry, so you can add as many as you want,
- The Info and Reset panels are now both text-based with minor graphics,
- Change to colour scheme and design.


Thank you for using OpenDraft, and looking forward to your feedback!

notes.title: Update Notes - January 16th, 2025
notes.content:
[u][b]January 16th, 2025 - Update[/b][/u]

[h1]Hello Drafters! [/h1]

Thank you so much for your continued support, suggestions, and your feedback! It means a lot and I am extremely happy that many of you have found OpenDraft useful and beneficial. Being a week after launch, and with a few bugs being reported, I wanted to push a small and quick update with some minor improvements!

[h3]What's New & Improved:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved UI and UX - Added cursor icons to correspond to the currently active mode. Text, sketch, delete, image, and to-do lists.
[*] Controls Bar - Removed the controls bar and replaced it with a radial menu. Radial menu is toggled through the button in the top corner.
[*] Sound/Audio - Improved the ambient soundscapes and added a sound feedback to button clicks.
[*] Grid - Added a grid function that can be toggled from the menu. This simply adds a grid to the background (fixed) that also grows and generates with the canvas, and can easily be toggled on/off.
[*] Brush Size - Slightly increased the maximum size for the brush. Added a "solid line" feature; to draw solid lines instead of tapered lines, simply hold the shift button while using the sketch tool.
[*] Faster Panning - To increase panning speed, either with the mouse or arrow keys, hold the shift button while panning the camera/moving across the canvas.
[*] Bugs - Fixed some bugs related to the music player, the colour picker, and the achievements.
[/list]


Again, I just wanted to say thank you so much to all of you. Your support means the world to me!

If you would like to reach out, please do so either through the Community Hub, the Discord server, or through the Website/Email!

Happy Drafting!
